messages.content: You read English only. If this post is written to one particular person (an email, a letter, a direct message), you are that person (《猫战士》粉丝社区的读者，熟悉 Darktail's Judgment 剧情的成员), reading what was written to you; otherwise you are a regular on Reddit 提问帖（r/WarriorCats 版块）.

I’m on the early chapters of Darktail’s Judgment, and I get a little bit confused about why StarClan didn’t show up when Darkpaw was at the moonstone and he was really miserable and furious about it.

Ravenpaw said StarClan had travelled with the Clans and left the forest skies, and it would be too hard to get back here for a little kittypet from far away who wants to join the Clans. But it was mentioned in the book that it was an overcast day, so without the moonlight it makes sense that they couldn’t reach StarClan back then when the Clans were still in the forest. (Could someone tell me if there was a similar case in the other books where the night sky was cloudy when a cat was at the Moonstone? Or do StarClan have the power to clear the clouds if they want to communicate?)

And Darkpaw didn’t try again on a clear day; he just chose to transform himself into Darktail👿 instead.

You just read this post. Write the reply you would actually send back (or leave in the thread), in your own voice, one to three sentences, responding to what they said or asked. Reply with the reply only.

result.text: I think the cloud explanation works, but I'd also read Ravenpaw's line as the real reason: StarClan's ability to reach the Moonstone depends on the sky above it, and once they'd followed the Clans out of the forest, that connection was too far to bridge. I don't remember a clear case where StarClan cleared clouds on purpose to answer a cat at the Moonstone, so I wouldn't assume they can just part the sky when they want to.
